name: manual_29100f
claim: Google fallback credentials: the operator's environment already holds the Google AI Studio key as GEMINI_API_KEY and GOOGLE_API_KEY (existence confirmed by name only; the value is never printed, logged, committed or pasted). Configure the Google provider by reference, using OpenClaw onboarding's --secret-input-mode ref so the config stores the variable name, not the key, with google/gemini-3.8-flash at thinking level medium after the W&B default and ClinePass. A key pasted into chat or a file must be rotated.

decisions.notes: Operator note 2026-11-25; OpenClaw 2026.10.6 accepts GEMINI_API_KEY or GOOGLE_API_KEY for the google provider.

rationale: Operator note 2026-11-25; OpenClaw 2026.10.6 accepts GEMINI_API_KEY or GOOGLE_API_KEY for the google provider.
